tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: What Airfare Brain covers: airlines, how fees are researched and dated, what it does NOT do (no live fares, no booking), and what car hire at the destination airport typically costs.

tools.name: list_airlines
tools.description: List every airline with a fee table: name, IATA code, the date its fees were checked, and its page.

tools.name: airline_fees
tools.description: One airline's published extra fees (bags, seats, priority, check-in, changes, payment), each with the price range, when bought (at booking / later / airport), how it is charged, its source URL and the date checked. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: true_cost
tools.description: The true cost of a flight on one airline. Pass `fare` (the total for the whole party, from a flight-search tool or the person) to get fare + extras; without it you get the extras alone. Extras = what the person chooses (cabin bag, checked bag by kg, seat, priority, infants) for their party and trip,

tools.name: trip_at_airport
tools.description: The whole trip into one airport in one answer: the flight's extras on an airline (bags, seats, fees, as true_cost) AND what car hire there really costs (Car Rental Brain's measured median per day, car only, dated). findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: airline_fees · Public sink: true_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: airline_fees · Public sink: true_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_capabilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What Airfare Brain covers: airlines, how fees are researched and dated, what it does NOT do (no live fares, no booking), and the sister tool for car hire." → after: "What Airfare Brain covers: airlines, how fees are researched and dated, what it does NOT do (no live fares, no booking), and what car hire at the destination airport typically costs."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
